name: Southshore Town Hall
summary: At Southshore Town Hall, Magistrate Henry Maleb directs the town’s affairs and defenses. It remains one of Lordaeron’s last centers of civil authority, while the Alliance struggles to hold ground in the plagued north.

sections.title: A Bastion of Civil Rule
sections.body: Southshore Town Hall keeps human rule alive amid Lordaeron’s ruin. Magistrate Henry Maleb governs from his office, working with officials such as Kundric Zanden to secure supplies and preserve order. Undead press from nearby lands, Syndicate rogues threaten the region, and Hillsbrad’s border sees fierce skirmishes. From the hall, town leaders direct Southshore’s survival against these threats.

faq.q: Who leads the town from the Southshore Town Hall?
faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb leads Southshore’s civil government from the town hall, directing the settlement’s administration and defense.

faq.q: What is the strategic importance of Southshore Town Hall?
aliases: why does the town hall matter
faq.answer: Southshore Town Hall is one of the last seats of Lordaeron’s civil leadership in the north. Alliance members look to it for direction, bounties, and coordination against the Forsaken and Syndicate bandits.

faq.q: Who else works inside the town hall?
aliases: who is inside southshore town hall
faq.answer: Kundric Zanden and other civil servants work alongside Magistrate Henry Maleb inside the town hall, helping manage local affairs and town operations.

faq.q: How does the town hall maintain ties with the wider Alliance?
faq.answer: Southshore was part of the Kingdom of Lordaeron, and its leaders now rely heavily on the Alliance for reinforcements and supplies. That support helps defend the isolated coastal town against nearby hostile forces.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion arriving in the north, you can look to Southshore Town Hall for regional authority and help against nearby threats.
As a human traveler, you see Southshore Town Hall as a reminder of Lordaeron’s lost glory, where a working magistrate still upholds the banners of a shattered kingdom.
